census.workload_qualification: These are exact per-image quotient-state counts summed as an enumeration workload. They are not asserted to be a disjoint union of ambient placement sets.

scope.mathematical_consequence: The feature law is not invariant under the classification action: six classification orbits have more than one physical image dimension. Therefore a census on the 18 canonical representatives does not cover the other 342 distinct action images.
scope.not_claimed: No second-digit outcome is claimed for the 342 noncanonical action images.
scope.statement: Exact linear-rank audit of the arbitrary-quadratic antipodal rank-at-most-two feature law on every image of the 18 dense-shell h=0 representatives under the 24-element classification action.
